text: At its meeting held May 11 and 12, 2022, City Council appointed the following members to the TO Live Board for the following terms: • Lori DeGraw for a term of office starting as a public member on May 12, 2022 until May 31, 2022; and as Chair starting on June 1, 2022, and ending May 11, 2026, and until a successor is appointed • Gave Lindo for a term of office starting June 1, 2022, ending May 11, 2026, and until a successor is appointed. These new appointments fill the position held by Gabriel Michaan who resigned on March 1, 2022 and Robert Foster whose resignation as Chair takes effect on May 31, 2022.
The Board of Directors of TO Live received the item for information.
